papers.title: ORION Research Harness
papers.current_ceiling: The trust-domain law is exact on 1,000 cells under cryptographic independence; production/organizational promotion is not earned.
post_matrix_updates: The August 29 recovery preserved bounded closeout, external-trust-domain and cross-site-replay artifacts, including adverse terminals.
PR #1691 contains a cross-site replay whose scientific endpoints reproduce but whose known R0 locator defect remains part of the boundary.
load_bearing_adverse: The bounded execution-integrity study records d=1 false promotion 4/4 and d≥2 false promotion 0/4; the adverse d=1 regime must remain visible.
Cryptographic independence in one harness is not organizational independence.
The trust-domain frontier successor is preregistered but not executed.
Cross-site replay is not enough if governance roots are not genuinely separate.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The harness must validate trust-domain composition on at least two real systems with structurally different organizational governance, broad host/process faults, false-rejection endpoints and measured overhead.
papers.decisive_question: Across two or more independently governed real execution systems, does the trust-domain law predict forgeability and prevent false scientific promotion under host/process faults without unacceptable benign rejection or overhead?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Trust-domain composition gives a production-relevant law for scientific execution integrity when cryptographic roots are backed by genuinely independent organizations.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: Observed compromise/forgeability should follow support(alpha)⊆C and effective trust dimension d_eff, while independent-governance chains block false promotion and maintain acceptable benign replay.
papers.population_or_universe: Version-pinned real CI/provenance or attestation systems from at least two independent organizations/trust models, including E7/E15 interoperability.
papers.unit_of_analysis: Execution receipt/attestation chain × compromise set × fault condition × system.
historical_only_inputs: All 1,000-cell law sweep, bounded 18-case study and accessed cross-site replay
design: Bind chained Ed25519 attestation V2 and false-rejection definitions.
Select systems with organizationally independent key/governance roots.
Inject host, process, storage, clock, network and cleanup faults.
Compare cryptographic-only, same-organization multi-key and independent-governance chains.
Measure detection, false promotion, benign rejection, replay and overhead.
primary_endpoints: Benign false rejection and replay success.
Latency, storage, signing and recovery overhead.
negative_controls: Forged work delta with valid superficial envelope.
analysis_plan: Exact theorem-prediction comparison per compromise cell.
System/organization results reported separately before pooling.
False promotion is noncompensatory; benign rejection/overhead have frozen tolerances.
Cross-site reproduction is labelled reproducibility unless governance independence is externally established.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Exhaust the prospectively frozen fault×compromise grid for each real system; no sampling away catastrophic cells.
papers.success_gate: Zero false promotions in all d_eff≥2 independent-governance cells, exact agreement with the trust-domain law, bounded benign rejection/overhead and reproducible replay on at least two structurally different systems.
papers.refutation_gate: Any false promotion in the claimed independent-governance regime or systematic law mismatch refutes production promotion while preserving the bounded theorem.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if governance independence, key custody, fault injection, locator semantics or false-rejection denominators are not externally verifiable.
papers.authority_required: Independent organizations/key custodians plus deterministic cryptographic/provenance verifiers and an implementation-independent fault checker.

active_lane.collision_rule: Do not overwrite the known R0 locator defect or count same-governance cross-site execution as organizational independence.

immediate_safe_actions: Bind the chained Ed25519 V2 specification and false-rejection endpoints.
Identify two genuinely independently governed target systems.
Turn every preserved adverse receipt into a regression/mutation control.
forbidden_actions: Do not hide the d=1 4/4 false-promotion regime.
Do not equate multiple keys with independent governance.
Do not call replay scientific validity proof.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier systems/security paper needs exact theory, independently governed real systems, exhaustive hostile fault injection, benign rejection/overhead analysis and external key-custody authority.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns execution/trust integrity; scientific claim authority belongs to ORION-18 and research-process efficacy to ORION-24.
